tldr: Mercury through the 3rd house clarifies messages, conversations, learning, and daily movement.
body:
When Mercury moves through your 3rd house, it puts language around messages, conversations, errands, siblings, neighbors, learning, planning, and what needs to be said. You may notice more activity in your immediate world: conversations to have, details to track, short trips to make, or a decision that needs clearer words.

Something may need to be said, decided, written, questioned, or understood. It can help you name the question, make the call, or sort through the moving pieces.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for naming the thing that has been circling in your mind.

The caution: Watch for overthinking the situation until the simple next step disappears. The risk is getting scattered by every message, detail, or possible interpretation.

Mercury moves through this house for a few weeks. Use the mental activity for clarity. Say the thing plainly, then let the answer tell you what comes next.
